shared_gaps.missing: Exact current-work formulation, specimen and material state
shared_gaps.next_action: Locate the underlying record and identify the exact material in its original methods; keep family and sample identities separate.
shared_gaps.decision_relevance: Required before any measurement can be assigned to a candidate.

shared_gaps.missing: Gripper load, geometry, actuation mode, environment and acceptance limits
shared_gaps.next_action: Specify the proposed research prototype and mandatory bounds before numerical material screening.
shared_gaps.decision_relevance: Literature cannot choose the application acceptance requirements.

shared_gaps.missing: Material and functional measurements with units, baseline, conditions and uncertainty
shared_gaps.next_action: Review primary figures, tables, methods and available supplement for the same formulation and protocol.
shared_gaps.decision_relevance: Needed to distinguish a comparable pass/fail from a missing result.

shared_gaps.missing: Direct experiment connecting the formulation to the intended device function
shared_gaps.next_action: Determine whether the source reports a tested device, a coupon measurement, a simulation or only a proposed use.
shared_gaps.decision_relevance: A soft-robotics tag cannot fill a device-function requirement.

shared_gaps.missing: Biological compatibility result in the intended contact context
shared_gaps.next_action: Define the biological test context and obtain the matched assay, exposure, endpoint, controls and reporting details.
shared_gaps.decision_relevance: A paper-level biocompatibility tag is not a context-specific material acceptance result.

shared_gaps.missing: Comparable performance and adequate repeatability for the chosen use
shared_gaps.next_action: Check replicates, uncertainty, service cycles, creep and conditioning against the declared requirements; retain unknowns explicitly.
shared_gaps.decision_relevance: Citation totals and tag frequency cannot establish performance or robustness.

scope_limit: DPAL main article and supplement only. No additional candidate papers, model API calls or material-performance benchmark.
